title: Deep Video Discovery: Agentic Search with Tool Use for Long-form Video Understanding

layout.note: Two unframed halves side by side: on the left a sequence-style trace with three lifelines under header boxes and horizontal message arrows, on the right a radar chart with its legend at the lower right; the caption names them Left and Right.

lesson: Draw an agent run as a sequence diagram: one lifeline per actor in its own colour, typed text turns (Thought, Tool use, Observation) coloured by actor, a real question and answer at the two ends; pair it with a radar chart as the headline result.
